title: Refund Cooperation Relief after a Dispute Decision (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, a practice that has refunded overpayments directly earns relief on the first withholding Cascade books after a dispute decision.

**Clause.** The refund-cooperation relief to the post-decision withholding ceiling is set by the refunds received from the practice on the agreement's overpayments dated fewer than 24 whole months before today:

| Refunds received in the window | Ceiling points subtracted |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 8 |
| Exactly one | 4 |
| None | Nothing |

## Counting the refunds

- Count each refund-received entry on the agreement's overpayment ledger whose date is fewer than 24 whole months before today. Each is counted whichever overpayment it settled.
- Whole months are the difference in calendar months from the refund date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the refund date's day of the month.
- Withholdings from remittances are not refunds and are not counted.

## Hypothetical cases

- One refund 5 whole months ago and one 23 whole months ago: two refunds, so 8 points.
- One refund 24 whole months ago and no other: it is outside the window, so nothing.
- No refunds, but several withholdings: nothing.
